dedupe_keys.name: comreg siteviewer and outdoor mobile coverage map mobile and fixed wireless sites and modelled coverage ireland

description: ComReg runs two public map tools on Ireland's wireless networks. Siteviewer shows the locations of radio sites used by licensed operators, with filters by operator for mobile networks and for fixed wireless access, and details for each site; the application was built for ComReg by Odin Consultants. The outdoor mobile coverage map (coveragemap.comreg.ie) shows modelled outdoor coverage of each mobile operator by technology, from 2G to 5G, at a given location, with signal quality levels. Together they show where mobile and fixed wireless infrastructure stands and which areas depend on which operator. Coverage: Ireland. Format and access: free web map applications; no bulk download or documented API was found, although the applications load data from web services. Caveats: ComReg's main website refused automated requests in this session, so the site data sources, update dates, operator list and terms of use were not checked; the technology range and quality levels of the coverage map are from recall, and site data are operator-reported. Simulation uses: locating mobile and fixed wireless sites for hazard exposure (flooding, storms, power loss) and judging where losing one operator removes coverage. Related records: the ComReg gigabit broadband statistics cover fixed networks, and the Ofcom and Danish Mastedatabasen site databases are comparable.
